Help & Support

Need help with your household account or collection service?

Registration
Use your Gmail address, household address, phone number and assigned collection details when creating an account.
Login
Sign in with your Household ID and password. If your details are not accepted, check the Household ID format first.
Admin Panel
Only authorized authority personnel should use the Admin Panel.
Support
For local collection issues, contact your waste-collection authority and provide your Household ID.
